data.name: SUPER SCORE
data.detailed_description:
REACH FOR THE WIN

SUPER SCORE isn't about who gets the most kills, it's about who crosses the line.

Lead your squad of three in a high-speed battle where the only thing that counts is reaching the enemy base. Push forward, outmaneuver the opposition, and fight your way to the score zone - or fall back and shut down their runners before they reach yours. Every round is a tug-of-war between attack and defense, and every second matters.

Your weapons aren't here to rack up a kill count. They're tools, used to clear a path for your team or to stop the enemy dead in their tracks. Kills don't win games. Scores do.

MAPS THAT CHANGE THE GAME

Every arena brings a new puzzle. Alternate routes, deadly kill zones, and chokepoints force you to adapt your strategy on the fly. Learn the map, find the gaps, and exploit them before the other team does.

BUILD MOMENTUM OR GET LEFT BEHIND

Sprint your way through the chaos. SUPER SCORE rewards players who stay in motion. Use your full movement kit to create openings, dodge fire, and push the pace. Standing still is losing.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-10100 / AMD Ryzen 3 3100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Disc space will increase during Early Access as more content is added
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: windows 10, windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1070 / AMD RX 5600 XT
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Disc space will increase during Early Access as more content is added
